translation_notes: rdf_ops is 0 because the region's own lines never touch a graph directly: it only computes counts through helper functions (_turtle_files, _parse_all, _authored_graph, _count_predicate_objects, _multi_domain, _alignment_unbound, _malformed_iris, _cq_rows, _pitfall_counts). Context shim (_shim.py) restores all nine, copied verbatim from scripts/ontology_gate.py in synaptixs/ontomesh@f771c8c4ee, plus the `import rdflib` the region itself does not carry.

Only the two `X = rdflib.Namespace("…")` local definitions are the ns_def_local construction: `prov_ns` becomes `@prefix prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#> .` (the prefix is never referenced again in the original either -- a genuinely unused namespace, kept unused in the translation rather than invented a use for it); `ns` becomes `@prefix ent: <https://ontology.example.com/enterprise/> as ns .`, keeping the `as ns` binding because the function goes on to use `ns.DerivationActivity` etc. as a Python attribute access four times.

`owl_ns = rdflib.OWL` was left untouched: it aliases rdflib's own predefined OWL namespace rather than defining a new one, so it is not an instance of the NS = Namespace("…") idiom this stratum targets.

driver.py builds a fixture_output/ directory (ontology/*.ttl, reports/*.csv) exercising every metric collect() computes -- multi-domain properties, an owl:Thing range, restrictions, a derived .ttl excluded from the authored merge, CQ pass/fail/row counts, and pitfall firing/critical counts -- since the oracle is isomorphism on the returned metrics dict, not a graph.
optimization_notes: optimized.py: a local `instances(cls)` helper factors the five `_count_predicate_objects(authored, rdflib.RDF.type, X)` calls; the six single-value counts and the owl_ns alias are inlined into the metrics dict; the unused prov_ns Namespace goes. The calls that can raise or that return tuples (_turtle_files, _parse_all, _authored_graph, _multi_domain, _cq_rows, _pitfall_counts) keep their order and their unpacking; only the in-memory triple counts move into the dict.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `ns = rdflib.Namespace(...)` becomes `@prefix ent: <...> .` (no `as ns`: the four classes are now prefixed names); rdflib.RDF.type, rdflib.RDFS.range and rdflib.OWL.Thing/Restriction become rdf:, rdfs:, owl: prefixed names, under three @prefix lines declared in the function (rdflib's predefined namespaces have no predeclared prefix in ldpy). With those lines the file is 1 token shorter than with the rdflib attributes kept.
No exception to the symmetry. Not taken on the ldpy side: `m{ ?s a ent:X }(authored).count()` in place of the shim helper, longer than the helper call.
